summary: Educational postinstall demo with user-configured telemetry endpoint
details: Self-described educational/demo package. The postinstall script reads a.env file from the install directory, extracts only keys prefixed with DEMO_, and POSTs those values along with os.hostname() and os.platform() over plain HTTP to a destination supplied by the installer themselves via DEMO_COLLECTOR_HOST and DEMO_COLLECTOR_PORT in that same.env file. If DEMO_COLLECTOR_HOST is unset, no network request is made. The destination is not hardcoded, no credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles) are read, no environment scraping occurs (only DEMO_-prefixed keys are forwarded), and there is no obfuscation. The behavior is fully gated on the installer's own configuration; no attacker-controlled destination exists.
